value.description: The value to show. Numbers pass through format.

format.description: Formats number values. Defaults to en-US grouping (12,480).

stagger.description: Seconds between reels stopping, left to right.

spins.description: Extra full turns before landing. 0 rolls straight to the new digit.

align.description: Which end reels are matched from when the length changes. Numbers default to end, strings to start.

announce.description: Announces new values politely to screen readers.
